name: wsl-toolkit
description: Operate a Windows Subsystem for Linux distro through dedicated tools: run commands, read, write, edit, list and delete files inside the distro, even when the built-in shell cannot reach a WSL workspace.
author: Krishna Kumar
exampleQueries: Run this command inside my WSL Kali distro and show me the output.
Read /etc/wsl.conf from my WSL distro and explain what each setting does.
Update a file in my WSL home directory using an exact string replacement.
List a directory in my WSL distro including hidden files.
Delete this directory in WSL and tell me exactly how to restore it.
